title: Minecraft BEST CREEPER FARM Tutorial - NEW - +4900~6900/HR!
description:
In This Tutorial I Will Show you how to make The best creeper farm that you can build In Minecraft a creeper farm that is based on a new method, is much cheaper, and faster and it will have a specific gunpowder 100% rate that makes this farm so special in Minecraft that will be fine even in Minecraft 1.21 as well!

📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚In New Update platform patterns and creeper farm pattern spiders are changed to reach 100% stability!
📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +4,900 ~ +9,000 ( Drops / Gunpowder ) Depending on modules and perimeter and to reach 9k you have to use 4 modules each one should include 12 layers
📚This farm is non redstone circuit which makes this farm the best choice for beginners but even with redstone this farm is faster and the rate is extremely fast!
📚This farm is so fast and I highly recommend this farm to beginners.
📚This module uses a boat to activate and trigger it has a clock but the setup has a specific amount of delay to be activated and it does not even use a dispenser
📚This farm exactly uses a similar method to stacking raid farms to push creepers into the chambers except this one will be pushed at once this makes the farm so fast because if we think about it the water-pushing method will take time to push mobs to the chamber!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
